headline: Mark Zuckerberg doesn’t understand how to live
summary: This article critiques Mark Zuckerberg's AI manifesto and life philosophy. It questions the depth of AI-generated motivational messages like 'Do cool shit'. The author reflects on the disconnect between AI prompts and genuine human experience.

headline: Anker’s travel charger works in almost any country and is down to $20
summary: Anker's Nano Travel Adapter is a highly recommended gadget for international travelers. It can charge up to five devices simultaneously, making it ideal for phones, earbuds, and power banks. This versatile adapter is currently on sale for just $20.

headline: Bluesky now lets you hide reposts from that annoying person you follow
summary: Bluesky has introduced a new feature allowing users to hide specific individuals' reposts from their feeds. This tool helps de-clutter your timeline from unwanted shared content. It provides more control over what content appears in your feed, improving user experience.

headline: Costco’s great Switch 2 console bundle includes over $100 in free stuff
summary: The Nintendo Switch 2 price is set to increase to $499.99 on September 1st, 2026. Costco is offering a special $499.99 bundle for members before the price hike. The bundle includes a Nintendo Switch 2, a 256GB microSD Express card, and Switch Online Expansion benefits.

headline: AU Deals: Save $100 on a Gigabyte OLED Monitor and get Onimusha: Way of the Sword For Free
summary: Australian gamers can save $100 on a Gigabyte OLED Monitor. This deal also includes a free copy of the game Onimusha: Way of the Sword. It's a limited-time promotion for tech and gaming enthusiasts.

headline: Get a 36V 500W Adult Electric Bike for $275 Shipped During the AliExpress Back to School Sale
summary: An adult electric bike is available for $275, including shipping, via the AliExpress Back to School Sale. This 36V 500W electric-assisted bike can reach speeds of up to 23mph. It boasts a substantial range of up to 45 miles on a single charge.

headline: Ditch the Bubble Level, the Fanttik D2 Pocket Green Laser Level Is Priced Under $30
summary: The Fanttik D2 Pocket Green Laser Level is now available for under $30. This device offers a modern and precise alternative to traditional bubble levels. It helps users achieve perfectly straight alignments for various tasks.

headline: The JSAUX Screen Protector Is Dirt Cheap Insurance for Your Nintendo Switch 2 for Just $7
summary: A JSAUX screen protector for the Nintendo Switch 2 is available for an affordable price of just $7. The package includes three screen protectors, offering backups in case of application errors. It provides cheap insurance against scratches and damage for your new console.

headline: PM asks justice secretary to find way to keep PC Harper's killers in jail
summary: The Prime Minister has urged the justice secretary to explore options to keep PC Harper's killers imprisoned. Andy Burnham is reportedly confident a solution can be found. The goal is to exclude two of the killers from an early release scheme.

headline: Amber heat health alerts for almost all of England as next heatwave begins
summary: Amber heat health alerts have been issued for nearly all of England. The alerts will remain in place until Friday evening due to expected high and extreme temperatures. The country is preparing for another significant heatwave this week.

headline: Councils to get more powers to stop vape and betting shops, PM announces
summary: The Prime Minister announced that councils will receive enhanced powers to control the proliferation of vape and betting shops. This initiative aims to revitalize town centres. The PM stated that decades of decline have 'hollowed out' these vital community hubs.

headline: At least 132 killed in Colombia's largest earthquake in years
summary: A powerful earthquake in Colombia has tragically claimed the lives of at least 132 people. More than 480 individuals have been reported injured in the disaster. Fears remain that many more are trapped under collapsed buildings.
